definitions.gloss: dark soy sauce; standard Japanese soy sauce
definitions.explanation: The dark, full-flavored type of soy sauce, which accounts for over 80% of soy sauce consumed in Japan. The default when a recipe simply calls for しょうゆ.

examples.japanese: {濃口|こいくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃口|こいくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: Dark soy sauce is standard in the Kanto region.
For simmered dishes, dark soy sauce brings out better color and flavor.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧ (strong, thick) + ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth, flavor). Almost always used in the fixed expression {濃口|こいくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}, referring to the most common type of Japanese soy sauce. Predominant in eastern Japan (⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃口|こいくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}: dark soy sauce
- {濃口|こいくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use dark soy sauce
- {濃口|こいくち}⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧: prepared with dark soy sauce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄口|うすくち}→薄口：27554_usukuchi⟧: light soy sauce — lighter in color but actually saltier; common in ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧
- ⟦たまり{醤油|じょうゆ}→たまり醤油：27593_tamarijouyu⟧: tamari soy sauce — thicker, wheat-free or low-wheat
- {白醤油|しろじょうゆ}: white soy sauce — very pale, mild flavor
